scope: Max-level PvE guide baseline; no personal optimization.

stat_guidance.baseline: Intellect > Mastery > Haste = Critical Strike > Versatility.
stat_guidance.support: Mastery strengthens ally buffs and their duration. Versatility boosts own damage but not the support buffs; do not optimize only personal DPS.

content_overrides.reason: Guide prefers Recklessness when it grants Mastery.

conditions: Regular gems favour Mastery; ring/weapon choices are gear-dependent.
Guide's Mastery gem family mapped to Mastery-dominant Quick Amethyst from its live tooltip, with secondary Haste. This is a concrete matching example, not a simulated best gem.
unresolved: Exact item quality ranks and full use/cooldown restrictions not independently verified.
validation_scope: Guide-backed baseline and tooltip-verified linked identities; conditional examples and remaining limitations are explicit.
derivation_notes: Named examples were resolved from sourced stat-family requirements plus live item tooltips; no character simulation was performed.
